name: Nproc
description:
Nproc is a workspace where a team keeps its documents, issues, tables and whiteboards in one place.
Documents and issues are placed on a shared whiteboard and linked to each other visually, so a
decision and the discussion behind it stay together instead of scattering across tools. This
connector exposes that workspace to Claude, scoped to your own permissions on the teams and
workspaces you belong to.

Issues
List issues in a team, filtered by workspace, creator, assignee, due date, or open/closed status.
Search them full-text, additionally filtered by label and priority. Get one issue with its body,
every comment, and the documents, canvas items, table rows and issues linked to it. List the labels
defined in a workspace. Create an issue with a body, labels, priority, assignees and a due date.
Add a comment to an issue.

Documents
List documents in a team or workspace, most recently updated first. Search them full-text. Get one
document with its body and linked issues. List its edit history with per-version previews. Create a
document in a workspace.

Whiteboard
List and full-text search the notes on a workspace whiteboard, and get one note with its body.
List the tables, read a table's column schema including select options, and query its records with
column filters, sorting, and an optional list of the issues and documents that reference each row.

Comments
Search comments across issues by keyword or by author.

Teams and people
List the teams you belong to, the workspaces you can see in a team, and the members of a team or a
workspace with their roles.

Handbook
Fetch the Nproc handbook: plans, pricing, billing, features, limits, roles and how-to.

Most tools read. The three that write create an issue, create a document, or add a comment.
Nothing on the whiteboard is written. Nproc does not train any AI model on your data and has no
built-in AI features.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Nproc to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Nproc to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://nproc.net/mcp/v1. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Nproc MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nproc lists 23 MCP tools, including add_comment, create_document, create_issue, get_document, get_handbook, get_issue, get_note, get_table_schema, list_document_history, list_documents, list_issue_labels, and list_issues.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Nproc?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Nproc in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Nproc requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Nproc is developed by TR-55 Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
